source_event.finding: temporal acknowledgement boundary allowed worker-clock drift after partial failure

generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: An asynchronous consumer acknowledges a persisted source event before every business-time effect derived from that event is durable or reconstructible, so restart can substitute processing time for event time.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: The happy path forwards the correct event timestamp, but a crash after acknowledgement removes the source from the pending queue and a generic retry starts the window from now.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Persist the event-time-derived effect before acknowledging the source, or retain a durable canonical timestamp that every retry must reconstruct before using any worker clock.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Inject failure before the derived effect and after the effect but before acknowledgement; after restart, assert the same canonical event timestamp and reject worker-time fallback.

transfer_cases.evidence: Control requires failure injection on both acknowledgement boundaries.
Control generalizes to any derived deadline whose source event can disappear after acknowledgement.
